one_line: Personal-finance web app: bank data via Quiltt, spending analytics, budgets and plans, reports, email, admin; FastHTML + JS, omxqua Ledger, phone and laptop
verdict: Not today: most screens (lists, budgets, plans, analytics tables) map to tested mojoui pieces on Linux and web, but sign-in, per-tenant data, HTTPS, the Flow chart, drawers and real phone builds are missing.

features.feature: Laptop shell: top islands, collapsible sidebar, nav
Phone shell: floating tab bar, touch-size targets
features.gap: No bottom-tab island component for the compact shell; Overlay never run on a phone

features.feature: omxqua Money · Ledger skin, light and dark
features.evidence: components.md: Themes on top, Light and dark from the system

features.feature: Liquid motion: card grows into a focus view, drawers slide, press feedback
features.gap: Springs drive canvas drawing only; native views have no slide/morph transitions (a Transition modifier the hosts animate)

features.feature: Beacon while a bank sync runs
Bento: Safe to spend, Needs you, accounts, upcoming bills, where the month's money went
Pace line chart and category donut
features.evidence: tests/test_charts.mojo; no donut/pie mark in mojoui.charts or flint
features.gap: No donut/pie mark

features.feature: Phone gestures: drag a sheet down to close, swipe rows and view strips
features.gap: Swipe and drag only on a Canvas; no .on_swipe for native views, no bottom Sheet

features.feature: Dense list (laptop) and lean rows (phone), search, category dropdown
features.omx_piece: DataGrid · LazyList · mojoui.fields (search box) · mojoui.sqlite FTS5 · Dropdown

features.feature: Detail drawer: edit, hide, deductible, returning, split, notes
features.gap: No side drawer (laptop) / bottom sheet (phone) component; Dialog is the nearest

features.feature: Drill-in: tap any chart part to open its transactions in a drawer
features.gap: Needs the same Drawer component

features.feature: Rules: auto-categorize, create, delete, apply to history
Live: Position, Rhythm (month calendar), Where it went
features.omx_piece: ChartView bars/lines/Heatmap · Sparkline · sheetpage month/weekday group-bys
features.gap: No calendar chart (days in a month grid, tap a day); Heatmap only approximates it

features.feature: Flow: category → merchant bands, dive in, play the months
features.evidence: no flow/Sankey chart in mojoui.charts or flint
features.gap: A Flow (Sankey) chart in mojoui.charts with hit-test and Spring animation

features.feature: Cross-filter: category × merchant × time linked
features.omx_piece: sheetpage compute() group-bys · ChartView selection · mojoui.links
features.evidence: tests/test_chartask.mojo; mojoui/links.mojo links cards, not chart selections
features.gap: A generic CrossFilter: a selection on any chart filters the page's other charts (on the MX frame)

features.feature: Shift and Month by month: a period vs the prior one, category table
Merchants, Subscriptions, Recurring lenses
Shared filters, pills, themed dropdowns
features.omx_piece: Segmented · Dropdown · mojoui.fields filter chips · mojoui.header pill tabs

features.feature: Budgets with progress, insights, icon picker
Goals and recurring obligations
Planning shelf: 13 calculators (rent vs buy, runway, debt, afford, mortgage, car, bonus, home value) with charts
features.evidence: tests/test_charts.mojo (math is app code, ported to Mojo)

features.feature: Vacation trip tags + emailed trip report; tax evidence pack, year report, CSV
features.omx_piece: mojoui.csvio · FileSaver · mojoui.http (to the server that emails)
features.gap: Email stays server-side (fh-saas); the client needs HTTPS to reach it

features.feature: Personal (scrapbook) and Business (invoice) reports, same on screen and in print, up to 4 photos
features.gap: No print/PDF of a view tree (browser print, GTK print, NSPrintOperation); packpdf is a separate HTML path

features.feature: Connect a bank with the Quiltt Connector
features.omx_piece: WebComponent (JS widget in a web view)
features.gap: Wrap a third-party JS SDK (Quiltt) with its HTTPS origin and popups; native Quiltt SDKs on phones

features.feature: Accounts, connections, refresh, status, net-worth history
features.evidence: tests/test_http.mojo; mojoui/http.mojo TLS_NEEDED: plain HTTP only
features.gap: HTTPS in mojoui.http (TLS backend, needs Mojo ≥ 1.2 / flare)

features.feature: Bank sync jobs and Quiltt webhooks, job status
features.gap: Server side is fh-saas's job, not omxcode's; the client side needs HTTPS

features.feature: Google sign-in, sessions, logout
features.evidence: mojoui/hosts/web.py: per-tab sessions, no user identity; no OAuth/keychain in mojoui
features.gap: Auth bridge: the web host mounted inside fh-saas (session → signed-in user); native OAuth (system browser + PKCE, token in the keychain)

features.feature: One SQLite per tenant, household members and invites
features.evidence: web.py runs every tab in one process (MAX_SESSIONS 200) with no tenant context; mojoui.sqlite opens one local file
features.gap: Per-session tenant context in the web host (user → tenant DB path) and fh-saas as the data API for native clients

features.feature: Stripe pricing, checkout, billing portal, trial and payment banners
features.gap: An open_url effect (system browser / new tab) to hand off to Stripe Checkout

features.feature: Email: welcome, invites, budget and low-balance alerts, weekly summary
features.gap: Stays in fh-saas by design; nothing for omxcode to add

features.feature: Install as an app (manifest, service worker), phone push
features.gap: PWA manifest + service worker from the web host; notify() on iOS/Android

features.feature: Welcome flow and a sample workspace you try without signing in
features.omx_piece: app state with sample data (mojoui.sample / contoso pattern)

features.feature: Sign-in page with an animated money scene
Landing, pricing, security, privacy, terms, about, contact pages
features.omx_piece: mojoui.markdown could render the legal pages
features.evidence: docs/probes.md: marketing sites are not where omxcode competes
features.gap: Out of scope by design: these stay plain FastHTML (SEO, first paint)

features.feature: One scrolling Settings page: notifications, household, billing link
Host console: tenants, logs, exports, SQLite downloads, amount diagnostics
features.gap: Needs the auth bridge (admin role) and HTTPS; the screens themselves exist

wins.what: Every screen is an agent's tool set for free: 'what did I spend on dining in October', 'hide this transaction', 'make a trip report' through MCP, with no per-app work (finxplorer has no agent features)
Questions in words become SQL over the transactions (Ask → SQL), answered in place
wins.evidence: mojoui/asksql.mojo, tests/test_asksql.mojo (omxplorer's tables, not finance data yet)

wins.what: Local-first native app: the tenant's SQLite in process opens and searches faster than the web can
wins.evidence: docs/probes.md Jot: cold open 6.6×, search p95 2.6× vs SQLite-wasm on OPFS (Linux; phones unproven)

wins.what: GPU group-bys behind Shift, Month by month and cross-filter
wins.evidence: unproven at this scale: omxplorer groups 1M rows on the GPU, but a household has ~10–50k transactions, which JS handles today; a win only for multi-year business books or the admin console across tenants

wins.what: Charts drawn by Mojo look and animate the same on every host (no ECharts plus hand-written SVG mix)
The 13 calculators' maths and their screens in one language and one file each, instead of a pure-JS file plus a UI file

top_gaps.gap: Sign-in and tenants: the web host inside fh-saas, session → user → tenant DB; native OAuth with keychain
unblocks: One SQLite per tenant, household members and invites

top_gaps.gap: HTTPS in mojoui.http, so native apps reach the finxplorer API
unblocks: Accounts, connections, refresh, status, net-worth history
Bank sync jobs and Quiltt webhooks, job status
Vacation trip tags + emailed trip report

top_gaps.gap: Drawer / bottom Sheet and swipe on native views
Finance charts: Flow (Sankey), donut, calendar, and a CrossFilter between charts
unblocks: Pace line chart and category donut

top_gaps.gap: Phones for real: bottom-tab island, and DataGrid/Pivot/Overlay run on iOS and Android (today ❌ or never run)
Print/PDF of a view, same on screen and paper
top_gaps.piece: host print (browser print, GTK print, NSPrintOperation)

top_gaps.gap: Third-party JS SDK inside a WebComponent (Quiltt Connector)
Transitions for native views (slide, morph from source)
top_gaps.piece: Transition modifier animated by each host

top_gaps.gap: Open a URL in the system browser
Installable web app and phone push
top_gaps.piece: web host manifest + service worker; notify on phones
unblocks: Install as an app, phone push
